T-001.Title: OPEN_FOLDER dispatcher in the project store

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `OPEN_FOLDER(pathname, { mode: 'add' | 'replace' | 'ask', origin })` exists in project.js. add → existing ADD_PROJECT + walk flow; ask with zero roots resolves to add, otherwise sets a pending choice consumed by a new `RESOLVE_FOLDER_CHOICE('add' | 'replace' | 'cancel')` action; replace goes through `_replaceWorkspace` which closes foreign roots and opens the new one. Log markers BLOCK_OPEN_FOLDER_RESOLVED (mode, origin) and BLOCK_WORKSPACE_REPLACED (closed, tabsClosed, dirtyHandled) replace BLOCK_WORKSPACE_OPENED. Watcher-driven tree additions skip dot-prefixed entry names (parity with the Rust walk), pinned by test. OPEN_RECENT_FOLDER stays add-semantics (session restore depends on it); dedup/nested/parent rejection unchanged and still localized.

New sideBar/workspaceModeDialog.vue renders the pending choice from T-001 (localized title/message/Add/Replace/Cancel, Add focused as default, Replace labeled destructive) and is mounted at the app level. Folder drop (app.vue `mt::open-folder-as-workspace` handler), clipboard folder (both direct and App-Store re-pick paths in clipboardOpen.js), Recent-folder activation (recent/index.vue) and the sidebar folder-switcher pick (ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT default mode ask) all route through OPEN_FOLDER ask-mode; no other behavior change on those surfaces.

_replaceWorkspace computes tabs under foreign roots: dirty ones trigger a Save & Close / Don't Save / Cancel confirm (same three-action pattern as the FIX-011 unsaved-close dialog; Cancel aborts with zero mutations — roots, tabs and dirty flags untouched), Save & Close saves then closes them, Don't Save closes unsaved; non-dirty tabs under removed roots close silently; tabs not under any root and tabs under the kept root always survive. Closing a root via its X (CLOSE_PROJECT) still never closes tabs — now pinned by an explicit test. Target already open as the only root → dedup notice, no destructive close.

T-004.Title: Menu, command registry and palette entries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: m009_menu.rs gains file.add-folder "Add Folder…" (CmdOrCtrl+Shift+O, replacing the retired file.open-folder row in the same position) and file.replace-workspace "Replace Workspace…" (no accelerator) in both the native builder and the standard_menu() taxonomy; in-file Rust tests (no_duplicate_ids, every_leaf_has_command_or_is_dynamic_submenu id_dispatched_only match, taxonomy order) updated. commands/index.js registers both ids (Add → ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT('add'), Replace → ASK_FOR_OPEN_PROJECT('replace')) and drops file.open-folder; descriptions.js maps both to new locale keys; menu-consistency passes in both directions.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: searchResultItem.vue computes `ownerPath` — owning root display name plus the relative directory (`Notes/2026`; bare root name when the file sits directly in the root) — and renders it in the restored dimmed row; hidden when no owning root matches. Pinned by component test including a two-root collision case.

tabs.vue computes `duplicateSuffix(file)`: when two or more open tabs share a filename, each shows a dimmed suffix with the owning-root name (parent directory for tabs outside every root); absent otherwise; full pathname stays the native tooltip; suffix never truncates the filename. Pinned by component test.

The file-open path is audited: an injected read failure (including a synthetic `Mobile Documents` path) shows a localized notice — existing notice path strengthened if it is silent today.

C-1.Name: Add never destroys
C-1.Expected: With two roots open and a dirty tab in each, choosing Add (explicit command or chooser default) leaves both roots, both tabs and both dirty flags bit-identical; the only change is one appended root.

C-2.Name: Replace with dirty work — Cancel is a no-op
C-2.Expected: Replace whose removed roots own dirty tabs shows Save & Close / Don't Save / Cancel; Cancel leaves roots, tabs, dirty flags and the picker result discarded — zero mutations, log shows the abort; Don't Save closes those tabs without writing; Save & Close persists before any root closes.

C-3.Name: One chooser, everywhere the same
C-3.Expected: Folder drop, clipboard folder, Recent activation and switcher pick with roots open all open the identical chooser with Add focused and the same consequence copy; explicit menu Add/Replace never show it; with zero roots every path opens directly.

C-4.Name: Duplicate and nested roots stay deterministic
C-4.Expected: Replace targeting an already-open root keeps the workspace (dedup notice, no mass close); a root nested inside an open root and a parent of an open root are both rejected with the existing localized notices in add and replace modes alike.

C-5.Name: Root X vs Replace tab rules
C-5.Expected: CLOSE_PROJECT (root X) never closes tabs — pinned; Replace closes exactly the tabs under removed roots (after the dirty confirm) and never touches rootless or kept-root tabs; untitled drafts survive every path.

C-6.Name: Restore degrades without cascade
C-6.Expected: Ordered multi-root restore with one missing root: notice lists it, every available root still opens, tabs and active tab restore, session autosave is not corrupted by the skip (missing root stays in prefs for when it returns).

C-7.Name: iCloud hygiene
C-7.Expected: `.Name.md.icloud` never enters the tree (walk skip + new watcher dot parity, both pinned); opening a file whose read fails shows a localized notice; paths containing spaces and a `Mobile Documents` segment canonicalize, dedup and restore correctly in tests.

C-8.Name: Security unchanged
C-8.Expected: No new IPC commands, no path-trust changes: watch/pick still pass m010 check_path; chooser and notices never log more path detail than existing markers; no locale file carries non-product content.

C-9.Name: UX: visible and honest
C-9.Expected: Chooser states what Replace closes; search owner label reads `Root/dir` dimmed under the filename and never crowds single-root results into misreading; tab suffix is dimmed and never truncates the filename; menu vocabulary matches the approved concept (Add Folder… / Replace Workspace…).

C-10.Name: Performance
C-10.Expected: Chooser adds one dialog render (no watcher/search work); duplicateSuffix and ownerPath are computed per render without O(n²) scans on large tab counts (precomputed filename map); watcher dot-skip is a prefix check; no measurable regression in the pinned suites.

C-11.Name: Registry and governance stay locked
C-11.Expected: menu-consistency passes both directions with the two new ids and the retired one gone; Rust m009 in-file tests pass (ids, order, dispatch); graph/verification deltas land in the same change; grace lint zero errors.

Correctness.Note: Corner walk found one real defect: the restore-degradation notice copy promised the missing roots «stay in the session», but the debounced session autosave persists the LIVE root set, so the missing root drops out of lastSessionFolders on the next write — the promise was false. Fixed: honest copy in all ten locales (lists the paths, promises nothing). Also reviewed and accepted: on Save & Close with multiple dirty tabs, tabs saved before a later save failure remain saved-but-open (content preserved on disk, nothing discarded) — not a Cancel-path mutation, corner C-2's zero-mutation guarantee is tested bit-identical for Cancel.

Security.Note: No new IPC commands (mt_pick_folder / mt_close_project_root / mt_response_file_save reused); watch/pick still gated by m010 check_path; new log markers carry no more path detail than the existing project-store markers; locale files carry product copy only.
